YOUR LIFE ONLINE

Years of posts, one journal.

Add the data exports you have downloaded (X/Twitter, Mastodon, Facebook, Instagram, Tumblr, Reddit, Google Takeout's Keep and Blogger) and get a dated .jot journal: your own words, a file a year, nothing retyped. It all happens in this browser: nothing is uploaded.

Your exports

Each export as the service gives it (a .zip), or unzipped (a folder: better for exports over a gigabyte). Add as many as you like; they become one timeline. How to download each one.

    What to bring in

    Besides your own posts and notes
    Where you mostly lived, e.g. Europe/London. Posts are dated by it.

    Never read: messages, contacts, friends lists, logins, IP addresses, ads data, location coordinates. Like and share counts are never written. Every file is marked private.
